notes.title: Commercial 0.35 Difficulty levels introduced to help with game learning curve pe
notes.content: Project toon tanks player base have requested a difficulty slider. Previously project toon tanks used a dynamic difficulty adjustment system embedded into the game. Due to player request I have added another layer of difficulty adjustment on top of the dynamic AI difficulty system. This should make the game more accessible for more casual audience.

notes.title: Commercial 0.34 MiG-29 is introduced to the diorama mode
notes.content: F-16 was added earlier in the game, This update adds the Russian MiG-29

notes.title: Commercial 0.33 Parachutes added
notes.content: As it turned out Parachutes can slow free falling things by a lot!

notes.title: SU-25 T was added as an alternative to A-10 C
notes.content: We are introducing SU-25 T for the story mode. Some say Project toon tanks does not have a story mode ... they just have not played it for long enough ...
